1. **/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/instantresumeranker/supabase/functions/create-razorpay-order/index.ts**
   - Creates Razorpay orders for one-time credit pack purchases
   - Calls `https://api.razorpay.com/v1/orders`
   - Uses `RAZORPAY_KEY_ID` and `RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET` environment variables
   - Inserts payment records with `razorpay_order_id` field

2. **/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/instantresumeranker/supabase/functions/verify-razorpay-payment/index.ts**
   - Verifies Razorpay payment signatures after checkout
   - Implements HMAC-SHA256 signature verification
   - Updates payment status to "paid" and adds credits to user profile
   - Handles plan activation with subscription expiry calculations

3. **/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/instantresumeranker/supabase/functions/create-razorpay-plan/index.ts**
   - Creates recurring billing plans in Razorpay (admin function)

   - Called when syncing plans to Razorpay payment gateway

   - Inserts payment tracking record

5. **/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/instantresumeranker/supabase/functions/cancel-razorpay-subscription/index.ts**
   - Cancels active Razorpay subscriptions at end of billing cycle
